title: One frame of a floor tour, at eye level in the Boardroom, with its parts named.
alt: A video frame at eye level in the Boardroom of Meridian HQ's Level 4: sofas, armchairs and a side table, a caption chip reading Boardroom 6.4 × 4.8 m in the lower left, and a small floor plan in the top-right corner with the Boardroom tinted blue and a blue dot and wedge in its top-left corner.

keys.text: **The shot.** Drawn by the same 3D view you see on the page, at 1920 × 1080 and 30 frames a second.
**The mini-map.** The floor's plan as a plain line drawing, in the corner away from the caption, at most a quarter of the frame's height.
**The room in shot** is tinted, so on a floor tour you can see which room you're in.
**The camera.** A dot where it stands and a wedge for what it sees. Both move with every frame.
**The caption** names the room and its size.
